text: 金十数据11月12日讯，华虹宏力(01347.HK)公告，拟3亿元~5亿元回购股份用于注销，回购价格不超过人民币255.55元/股（含），回购股份期限自股东会审议通过本次回购股份方案之日起12个月内。
text_en: Jinshi Data, November 12: Hua Hong Semiconductor (01347.HK) announced that it plans to repurchase 300 million to 500 million yuan of shares for cancellation, at a repurchase price of no more than RMB 255.55 per share (inclusive), with the repurchase period within 12 months from the date the shareholders' meeting approves the repurchase plan.
